vocabulary.term: Describe the Data Using the Median

vocabulary.definition: Using the middle value of the ordered data to say what is typical for the whole set.
vocabulary.definitionEs: Usar el valor del medio de los datos ordenados para decir qué es típico en todo el conjunto.
vocabulary.cloze: When one value sits far from the rest, describe the typical value with the ___.

examples.text: Reporting a median of 2 when one salary is 40
examples.why: The median stays with the group the outlier left behind.

examples.text: Reporting the mean of 6.75 for that same set
examples.why: No player earns anything near it.

vocabulary.definition: The middle number when you put them in order.
vocabulary.definitionEs: El número del medio cuando los pones en orden.
vocabulary.visual: Data: 1, 3, 5, 7, 9 → the middle (3rd) value is 5, so median = 5
vocabulary.cloze: The middle value of a data set when the numbers are in order is the ___.

examples.why: The middle value once the numbers are in order.
Middle of an unsorted list is not the median.

vocabulary.definition: The number that shows up most often.
vocabulary.definitionEs: El número que aparece más veces.
vocabulary.visual: Data: 2, 3, 3, 5, 7 → 3 appears twice (most often), so mode = 3
vocabulary.cloze: The value that appears most often in a data set is the ___.

examples.why: It appears more often than any other value.
It is the largest, not the most frequent.

vocabulary.definition: A number that is much bigger or smaller than the rest.
vocabulary.definitionEs: Un número mucho mayor o menor que los demás.
vocabulary.visual: Data: 10, 12, 11, 13, 50 → 50 is far from the others, so 50 is an outlier
vocabulary.cloze: A value that is much larger or smaller than the rest of the data is an ___.

examples.why: It is far from the other values.
It fits in with the rest of the values.

vocabulary.definition: How the data looks: where it sits and how spread out it is.
vocabulary.definitionEs: Cómo se ven los datos: dónde están y qué tan separados están.
vocabulary.visual: If most values cluster in the center with fewer at the ends, the distribution is symmetric
vocabulary.cloze: The overall shape of where the data values fall is the ___.

examples.text: “Most scores cluster near 85, with one down at 68”
examples.why: It says where the data sits and how it spreads.
One value describes a point, not the shape of the set.

vocabulary.definition: How spread out the numbers are.
vocabulary.definitionEs: Qué tan separados están los números.
vocabulary.visual: 8, 9, 10, 11 has low variability (close together); 2, 10, 25, 40 has high variability (far apart)
vocabulary.cloze: How much the data values differ from each other is the ___.

examples.why: The values differ, which is what variability measures.
Nothing varies, so there is no spread to describe.

vocabulary.definition: One number that describes a typical value in a data set.
vocabulary.definitionEs: Un número que describe un valor típico de un conjunto de datos.
vocabulary.visual: The median is one measure of center.
vocabulary.cloze: One number that describes a typical value is a ___.

examples.text: The median of the years of teaching experience
examples.why: The median is one number that stands for a typical value.
A count of the values does not describe a typical value.

vocabulary.definition: The number exactly between the two middle values of an even-count data set.
vocabulary.definitionEs: El número que está exactamente entre los dos valores centrales de un conjunto con una cantidad par de datos.
vocabulary.visual: Between 18 and 22, the halfway value is 20.
vocabulary.cloze: When a data set has two middle values, the median is the ___ between them.

examples.why: 20 is exactly the same distance from 18 and from 22.
18 is one of the middle values, not the number between them.

revealWordProblem.title: Apply: Real Estate
revealWordProblem.text: Terrance is helping his grandmother sell her house. He uses a real estate website to look at the recent sale prices of similarly‑sized houses in their area and collects the prices in the table shown. What would be a fair, but competitive, selling price for Terrance’s grandmother’s house? Use the median to justify your answer.
revealWordProblem.imageAlt: A real-estate sign reading Sold, showing a table of sixteen recent house sale prices.
revealWordProblem.sampleAnswer: Sort the 16 sale prices from least to greatest: $160,000, $199,900, $239,900, $269,900, $307,000, $382,900, $385,400, $401,785, $402,400, $405,400, $423,400, $426,400, $454,400, $457,400, $460,400, $485,250. With 16 values (an even number), the median is the average of the 8th and 9th values: ($401,785 + $402,400) ÷ 2 = $804,185 ÷ 2 = $402,092.50. A fair, competitive selling price would be around $402,000, since that's the middle of the market and isn't pulled up or down by the lowest sale ($160,000) or the highest sale ($485,250).

choiceFeedback: Did you forget to divide by the count of numbers?
Add the numbers first—does 14 equal the sum divided by 5?
Is 60 the mean, or the sum?
hints: Mean means the average of all five numbers — you'll need both a total and how many numbers there are.
Use the formula: mean = sum of the values ÷ how many values. Count first: there are 5 numbers here.
Step 1: add 10 + 14 + 8 + 12 + 16 to get the total. Then divide that total by 5 — the result is the mean.
hintsEs: La media es el promedio de los cinco números: necesitarás tanto un total como cuántos números hay.
Usa la fórmula: media = suma de los valores ÷ cuántos valores hay. Cuenta primero: aquí hay 5 números.
Paso 1: suma 10 + 14 + 8 + 12 + 16 para obtener el total. Luego divide ese total entre 5: el resultado es la media.

choiceFeedback: The lowest value is 3, but the median is the MIDDLE value, not the smallest. Put them in order first: 2, 3, 5, 7, 9.
5.2 is the MEAN — you added all five values and divided by 5. The median asks for the middle value after ordering, which is a different measure.
7 is in the list, but it is not in the middle once the values are ordered: 2, 3, 5, 7, 9. Count in from both ends.
hints: Median = the middle number, but only AFTER the list is in order. Don't pick the middle of the unsorted list.
Rewrite 3, 7, 2, 9, 5 from least to greatest, then count in from both ends until you reach the one value in the exact middle.
Start ordering: the smallest is 2, then 3... finish the ordered list of all five values, then circle the 3rd one — that's the median.
questions.explanationEs: Ordenados: 2, 3, 5, 7, 9. El valor del medio es 5.
hintsEs: La mediana es el número del medio, pero solo DESPUÉS de ordenar la lista. No elijas el del medio de la lista sin ordenar.
Reescribe 3, 7, 2, 9, 5 de menor a mayor y luego cuenta desde ambos extremos hasta llegar al único valor que queda justo en el medio.
Empieza a ordenar: el menor es 2, luego 3… termina la lista ordenada de los cinco valores y luego encierra el 3.º: esa es la mediana.

questions.explanation: 4 appears three times — more than any other value. Mode = 4.
choiceFeedback: 2 appears once—is mode the smallest or most frequent?
7 appears once—which number appears most often?
9 appears once—count how many times each number shows up.
hints: Mode is about repeats — which value shows up in the list more times than any other?
Make a quick tally: write each different number and count how many times it appears in 4, 7, 4, 9, 2, 4, 8.
Start your tally: 7 appears once, 9 appears once... keep counting every number and pick the one with the highest tally.
questions.explanationEs: El 4 aparece tres veces, más que cualquier otro valor. Moda = 4.
hintsEs: La moda tiene que ver con repeticiones: ¿qué valor aparece en la lista más veces que cualquier otro?
Haz un conteo rápido: escribe cada número distinto y cuenta cuántas veces aparece en 4, 7, 4, 9, 2, 4, 8.
Empieza tu conteo: el 7 aparece una vez, el 9 aparece una vez… sigue contando cada número y elige el de mayor conteo.

reviewHighlights.formula: Median = Middle value in an ordered set
steps: 1. Order all data values from least to greatest
2. Odd count: The median is the exact center number
3. Even count: The median is the mean of the two middle numbers
reviewHighlights.watchOut: A common mistake in Mean, Median, and Mode is finding the median without ordering the data first — students pick the middle number straight from the list as given (for 9, 4, 7, 2, 6 they say the median is 7, the middle position in that original order) instead of sorting least to greatest (2, 4, 6, 7, 9) and finding the true middle value, 6. Before finalizing a median, always reorder the data smallest to largest, then count to the middle position — and if there is an even number of values, average the two middle numbers.

level1.stem: Find the median of this data set: 4, 1, 7, 3, 9.
level1.stemEs: Halla la mediana de este conjunto de datos: 4, 1, 7, 3, 9.
hints: Put the values in order first.
hintsEs: Primero pon los valores en orden.
level1.explanation: Put the values in order: 1, 3, 4, 7, 9 Find the middle value: the 3rd is 4
level1.explanationEs: Pon los valores en orden: 1, 3, 4, 7, 9 Halla el valor del medio: el 3.º es 4

level1.stem: Find the median of this data set: 10, 2, 8, 6.
level1.stemEs: Halla la mediana de este conjunto de datos: 10, 2, 8, 6.
hints: Four values have two middle values.
hintsEs: Cuatro valores tienen dos valores del medio.
level1.explanation: Put the values in order: 2, 6, 8, 10 Find the number halfway between 6 and 8: (6 + 8) ÷ 2 = 7
level1.explanationEs: Pon los valores en orden: 2, 6, 8, 10 Halla el número a medio camino entre 6 y 8: (6 + 8) ÷ 2 = 7

level1.stem: Six students read 3, 9, 5, 12, 4 and 8 books. What is the median?
level1.stemEs: Seis estudiantes leyeron 3, 9, 5, 12, 4 y 8 libros. ¿Cuál es la mediana?
hints: Order the six values. Find the two middle values.
hintsEs: Ordena los seis valores. Halla los dos valores del medio.
level1.explanation: Put the values in order: 3, 4, 5, 8, 9, 12 Average the two middle values: (5 + 8) ÷ 2 = 6.5
level1.explanationEs: Pon los valores en orden: 3, 4, 5, 8, 9, 12 Promedia los dos valores del medio: (5 + 8) ÷ 2 = 6.5

level1.stem: Find the median of this data set: 3, 8, 5, 1, 9.
level1.stemEs: Halla la mediana de este conjunto de datos: 3, 8, 5, 1, 9.
hints: Put the values in order first. Then find the one in the middle.
hintsEs: Primero pon los valores en orden. Luego halla el del medio.
level1.explanation: Put the values in order: 1, 3, 5, 8, 9 Find the middle value: 5 values → the 3rd is 5
level1.explanationEs: Pon los valores en orden: 1, 3, 5, 8, 9 Halla el valor del medio: 5 valores → el 3.º es 5

level1.stem: Find the median of this data set: 12, 4, 10, 6.
level1.stemEs: Halla la mediana de este conjunto de datos: 12, 4, 10, 6.
hints: There are 4 values. Find the two middle values after you order them.
hintsEs: Hay 4 valores. Halla los dos valores del medio después de ordenarlos.
level1.explanation: Put the values in order: 4, 6, 10, 12 Find the two middle values: 6 and 10 Find the number halfway between them: (6 + 10) ÷ 2 = 8
level1.explanationEs: Pon los valores en orden: 4, 6, 10, 12 Halla los dos valores del medio: 6 y 10 Halla el número a medio camino entre ellos: (6 + 10) ÷ 2 = 8

level2.stem: Mia says the median of 9, 2, 7 is 2 because 2 is in the middle of the list. Is she right? What is the median?
level2.stemEs: Mia dice que la mediana de 9, 2, 7 es 2 porque el 2 está en el medio de la lista. ¿Tiene razón? ¿Cuál es la mediana?
hints: Mia skipped a step. What must you do to the values first?
hintsEs: Mia se saltó un paso. ¿Qué debes hacer primero con los valores?
level2.explanation: Put the values in order first: 2, 7, 9 Find the middle value: the middle is 7
level2.explanationEs: Primero pon los valores en orden: 2, 7, 9 Halla el valor del medio: el del medio es 7

hints: Decimals order the same way whole numbers do.
hintsEs: Los decimales se ordenan igual que los números enteros.
level2.explanation: Put the values in order: 1.5, 2.5, 3, 4, 6 Find the middle value: 5 values → the 3rd is 3
level2.explanationEs: Pon los valores en orden: 1.5, 2.5, 3, 4, 6 Halla el valor del medio: 5 valores → el 3.º es 3

level2.stem: Find the median of this data set: 11, 5, 8, 14, 6.
level2.stemEs: Halla la mediana de este conjunto de datos: 11, 5, 8, 14, 6.
hints: Order the values, then find the middle one.
hintsEs: Ordena los valores y luego halla el del medio.
level2.explanation: Put the values in order: 5, 6, 8, 11, 14 Find the middle value: 5 values → the 3rd is 8
level2.explanationEs: Pon los valores en orden: 5, 6, 8, 11, 14 Halla el valor del medio: 5 valores → el 3.º es 8

level2.stem: Four scores have a median of 15. Three scores are 10, 14 and 20. The missing score is between 14 and 20. Find it.
level2.stemEs: Cuatro puntajes tienen una mediana de 15. Tres puntajes son 10, 14 y 20. El puntaje que falta está entre 14 y 20. Hállalo.
hints: The two middle values must add to 15 × 2.
hintsEs: Los dos valores del medio deben sumar 15 × 2.
level2.explanation: Order the scores with the missing one: 10, 14, ?, 20 Write the median equation: (14 + ?) ÷ 2 = 15 Work backward: 15 × 2 = 30; 30 − 14 = 16
level2.explanationEs: Ordena los puntajes con el que falta: 10, 14, ?, 20 Escribe la ecuación de la mediana: (14 + ?) ÷ 2 = 15 Trabaja hacia atrás: 15 × 2 = 30; 30 − 14 = 16

level2.stem: A store sold 20, 35, 25 and 30 sandwiches on four days. What is the median number of sandwiches?
level2.stemEs: Una tienda vendió 20, 35, 25 y 30 sándwiches en cuatro días. ¿Cuál es la mediana de sándwiches?
hints: There are 4 values, so there are two middle values.
hintsEs: Hay 4 valores, así que hay dos valores del medio.
level2.explanation: Put the values in order: 20, 25, 30, 35 Find the two middle values: 25 and 30 Find the number halfway between them: (25 + 30) ÷ 2 = 27.5
level2.explanationEs: Pon los valores en orden: 20, 25, 30, 35 Halla los dos valores del medio: 25 y 30 Halla el número a medio camino entre ellos: (25 + 30) ÷ 2 = 27.5

level3.stem: Find the median of this data set: 12, 7, 15, 9, 20, 11, 8.
choiceFeedback: That is the middle of the list as written. Order the values first: 7, 8, 9, 11, 12, 15, 20.
That is the first value listed, not the middle one. Sort the seven values and take the 4th.
That is the 4th value before sorting. The median is the 4th value AFTER sorting.
level3.explanation: Ordered: 7, 8, 9, 11, 12, 15, 20. There are 7 values, so the median is the 4th one: 11.

level3.stem: Jon says adding the value 50 to 3, 5, 6, 8 will raise the median by a lot. What is the new median?
level3.stemEs: Jon dice que agregar el valor 50 a 3, 5, 6, 8 subirá mucho la mediana. ¿Cuál es la nueva mediana?
hints: Find the median before and after. Count the values each time.
hintsEs: Halla la mediana antes y después. Cuenta los valores cada vez.
level3.explanation: Find the median before: (5 + 6) ÷ 2 = 5.5 Add 50 and order the values: 3, 5, 6, 8, 50 Find the new middle value: the 3rd is 6
level3.explanationEs: Halla la mediana antes: (5 + 6) ÷ 2 = 5.5 Agrega 50 y ordena los valores: 3, 5, 6, 8, 50 Halla el nuevo valor del medio: el 3.º es 6

hints: Six values: find the two middle values after ordering.
hintsEs: Seis valores: halla los dos valores del medio después de ordenar.
level3.explanation: Put the values in order: 2, 3.5, 6.5, 7, 9, 10 Average the two middle values: (6.5 + 7) ÷ 2 = 6.75
level3.explanationEs: Pon los valores en orden: 2, 3.5, 6.5, 7, 9, 10 Promedia los dos valores del medio: (6.5 + 7) ÷ 2 = 6.75

level3.stem: Ages at a party are 11, 12, 12, 13, 14 and 45. Which value best describes a typical age?
level3.stemEs: Las edades en una fiesta son 11, 12, 12, 13, 14 y 45. ¿Qué valor describe mejor una edad típica?
hints: Which measure does one very large value not pull far?
hintsEs: ¿Qué medida no se mueve mucho por un valor muy grande?
level3.explanation: Find the median: (12 + 13) ÷ 2 = 12.5 Compare it with the data: most ages are near 12.5
level3.explanationEs: Halla la mediana: (12 + 13) ÷ 2 = 12.5 Compárala con los datos: la mayoría de las edades está cerca de 12.5
choiceFeedback: The age 45 pulls the mean up. Five of six people are younger than 17.8.
45 is one extreme value, not a typical one.
11 is the smallest value, not the middle.

level3.stem: Seven values have a median of 20. In order, the 3rd value is 18. You add two new values, 1 and 2. What is the new median?
level3.stemEs: Siete valores tienen una mediana de 20. En orden, el 3.er valor es 18. Agregas dos valores nuevos, 1 y 2. ¿Cuál es la nueva mediana?
hints: Two small values push the middle one place to the left.
hintsEs: Dos valores pequeños mueven el centro un lugar a la izquierda.
level3.explanation: Count the new number of values: 7 + 2 = 9 → the 5th is the middle Shift the old positions by two: old 3rd → new 5th Read the new middle value: the old 3rd value is 18
level3.explanationEs: Cuenta la nueva cantidad de valores: 7 + 2 = 9 → el 5.º es el del medio Mueve las posiciones viejas dos lugares: 3.º viejo → 5.º nuevo Lee el nuevo valor del medio: el 3.er valor viejo es 18
